_source: app.notion.com ComCom > Projects, 'on-going projects', Project name cell hovered and its Open (열기) pressed, 2026-08-06. Read-only: hover, one click on Open, Escape.

behaviour.click on the title text: edits in place inside the cell (focus goes to the contenteditable). The page does not open
behaviour.click on Open: side peek docked on the right. In that window x=1128 w=600 h=992 (full height)

unmeasured: how the side peek width follows the window size (600 is just one value measured in that window, and the user can resize this panel and have it remembered)
